steps.title: Remember that you now have useful …
steps.text: Remember that you now have useful teleports in your house. Especially the Arceuss ones to Morytania

steps.title: Complete Nature Spirit
steps.text: Complete Nature Spirit

steps.title: Complete Lost City. — You will …
steps.text: Complete Lost City. — You will need to visit Entrana. — You will need a teleport out, but the home teleport works fine

steps.title: Complete Fairy Tale Part 1. — …
steps.text: Complete Fairy Tale Part 1. — Hope you don't have to get a Nature Talisman. If you do, then you can make a detour and do Guardians of the rift for it, or try to kill Abyssal leechs in the Abyss. Be careful though, as your prayer get instantly drained when you go in the Abyss and you can die easily. — Reminder that you can store the Magic secateurs at any Tool Leprechaun.

steps.title: Partially complete Fairytale II until you …
steps.text: Partially complete Fairytale II until you can use fairy rings. — Your salve graveyard teleport will get you to a fairy ring very quickly

steps.title: Complete Garden of Death. — Remember …
steps.text: Complete Garden of Death. — Remember your house is near the minecart, which is pretty useful in this quest

steps.title: Train to level 34 Farming. — …
steps.text: Train to level 34 Farming. — Option 1 (Optimal) — Complete The Giant Dwarf. — Complete Forgettable Tale. — Complete Creature of Fenkenstrain. — Complete Garden of Tranquility. — Don't bother getting a fishing rod when you get up to the Edgeville monastery section, it's faster to simply destroy your Ring of charos and pickpocket a new one from Dr Fenkenstrain on the top floor of Fenkenstrain's Castle. — Option 2 (Lazy) — Purchase and use bagged plant 1s to get to level 31 (or 34) Farming. — Buy a chef's hat from Shayzien Styles. — Purchase garden pies in the Cooking Guild to boost to level 34.

steps.title: Train at Tithe Farm until level …
steps.text: Train at Tithe Farm until level 65 Farming

steps.title: Purchase a seed box and auto …
steps.text: Purchase a seed box and auto weed. — The extra points should be saved for later. — Keep Guam, Marrentil, and Harrlander seeds as 3 of your seeds. There are a few quests that need these, so you might want to pre-plant some. — It really isn't critical to rush to farm your seeds during questing. It is much easier to farm them while you settle into skilling grinds later.

steps.title: Clean up your inventory as it …
steps.text: Clean up your inventory as it is time to loot Wintertodt. — Make a games necklace and ring of dueling to help put items in your looting bag as you go

steps.title: Watch the videos for a more …
steps.text: Watch the videos for a more detailed explanation: — KEEP: — Herbs — Seeds — Gems — Magic Logs — Burnt pages (Drop if you don't get the Tome of Fire). — (Optional) Teak Logs — Can be made into planks during Construction. — DROP: — Ores — Other Logs — Fish — Saltpeter, pure essence, dynamite

steps.title: NOTE: My opinion on the Tome …
steps.text: NOTE: My opinion on the Tome of Fire is more mild now. It is nice to have, but not as critical really. You don't need to go back for it if you miss it unless you just want to. — Also, even if you do get the Tome, remember you will eventually drop it. Only hold it for awhile when you have extra bag space or if you want to use it at Zulrah with the Twinflame staff.

steps.title: Buy a few thousand Air runes
steps.text: Buy a few thousand Air runes

steps.title: Drop the staff of air
steps.text: Drop the staff of air

steps.title: (Optional) If you have extra Anima-infused …
steps.text: (Optional) If you have extra Anima-infused bark from earlier you can buy some Sawmill vouchers to save a bit of gp

steps.title: Configure your Rune Pouch to have …
steps.text: Configure your Rune Pouch to have Air, Earth, and Law runes in it

steps.title: Death bank at the Nightmare boss. …
steps.text: Death bank at the Nightmare boss. — You can Tithe Farm minigame teleport to you house, then take the Fenkenstrain Castle teleport to get back to the area. — (Optional) You could do the 70 Cooking grind right now while your inventory is clear. You will need it in the next section. — The step in the next section has more information about methods, but in short just do whatever you want the guide doesn't really care how you train.

steps.title: Collect the following items from your …
steps.text: Collect the following items from your death bank. — Guam leafs — uncut sapphires — uncut emeralds — uncut rubys. — Do NOT grab the uncut diamonds. You need those at the end of the guide. — Coins stack — Rune Pouch. Do NOT grab the water and fire runes for now. — You will use the portals in your house to teleport around for a bit.

steps.title: Cut your sapphires and emeralds
steps.text: Cut your sapphires and emeralds

steps.title: sell them at the Rogues' Den
steps.text: sell them at the Rogues' Den

steps.title: Cut your rubies
steps.text: Cut your rubies

steps.title: turn them in to the Museum …
steps.text: turn them in to the Museum Curator

steps.title: Turn all of the guams into …
steps.text: Turn all of the guams into attack potions

steps.title: Drop the potions
steps.text: Drop the potions

steps.title: Train to level 50 Crafting by …
steps.text: Train to level 50 Crafting by blowing glass in Port Phasmatys. — Method Link

steps.title: Return to your death bank and …
steps.text: Return to your death bank and pull out the items needed for Construction. Look at the inventory setup at the bottom of this section for reference. — You can buy the rune axe at Perry's Chop-chop Shop. — If you get lucky and happen to get a Dragon axe from Wintertodt then you can use that. It's worth keeping because you can put it in a STASH unit once you finish the construction grind. — Replace the fire runes with your tome of fire if you got it.

steps.title: Purchase another Banana hat to improve …
steps.text: Purchase another Banana hat to improve your fashion

steps.title: Train Construction until level 82 using …
steps.text: Train Construction until level 82 using teak Mahogany Homes. — Listen to this video for some notes on this. — Buy a Plank sack when you can. Save the extra points for the future. — Use the Auburnvale sawmill. (If you happen to have the Ring of the Elements from previous versions of the guide, it's better to use the Varrock Sawmill. — Don't worry about farming seeds right now. — If you don't want to go all the way to level 82, you could stop at 75 and use a spicy stew boost to make the jewelry box. This isn't as good, but does get you on your way a lot sooner. — There are aggressive Ghouls outside of the Salve Graveyard teleport. Don't full afk right after teleporting and die. Several people have done this already. — If you are playing with lower attention, you might want to make a ring of life if you don't have one left over from The Lost Tribe. — You can also just take everything out of death bank and keep it in a looting bag for safety. — You can also use a different method to reach a fairy ring, such as from the Ardougne cloak 1. — Seriously guys, please heed this warning! Another person died... It can happen to you! If you are not paying full attention take precautions!!!

steps.title: Make some Teak shelves 2 so …
steps.text: Make some Teak shelves 2 so you can create tea with a +3 boost

steps.title: Make an Achievement gallery and then …
steps.text: Make an Achievement gallery and then basic jewlery box in your house

steps.title: Create a Portal nexus and then …
steps.text: Create a Portal nexus and then a Mounted digsite pendant. — Rubies can be bought at various gem stalls, but one in Aldarin has a cut and uncut in stock

steps.title: (Optional) Make a Restoration pool, which …
steps.text: (Optional) Make a Restoration pool, which will be useful later and can be upgraded in the future

steps.title: (Optional) Build a bedroom and Servant's …
steps.text: (Optional) Build a bedroom and Servant's money bag to store up to 3m gp in your house

steps.title: (Optional) Upgrade your POH storage furniture …
steps.text: (Optional) Upgrade your POH storage furniture — Teak planks — Teak armour case — Teak fancy dress box — Teak magic wardrobe — Carved teak magic wardrobe — Teak treasure chest — Mahogany planks — Mahogany armour case — Mahogany fancy dress box — Mahogany magic wardrobe — Mahogany treasure chest
